題目：最長共同子序列（Longest Common Subsequence, LCS）虛擬碼 

LCS_LENGTH(X, Y)
1  m <- length[X]
2  n <- length[Y]
3  for i <- 1 to m
4       do c[i, 0] <- 0
5  for j <- 1 to n
6       do c[0, j] <- 0
7  for i <- 1 to m
8       do for j <- 1 to n
9            do if x_i = y_j
10                 then c[i, j] <- __AAA__
11                      b[i, j] <- "↖"
12                 else if c[i-1, j] >= __BBB__
13                      then c[i, j] <- c[i-1, j]
14                           b[i, j] <- "↑"
15                      else c[i, j] <- __CCC__
16                           b[i, j] <- "←"
17 return __DDD__
選出正確的

正確答案：
BBB 是 c[i-1, j]
CCC 是 c[i, j-1]

題目：下列有關最佳子結構，正確的是？

正確答案：
問題的最優解包含子問題的最優解
可透過局部優化達到全局最優
是動態規劃的基本前提

題目：最長共同子序列（Longest Common Subsequence, LCS）虛擬碼 

LCS_LENGTH(X, Y)
1  m <- length[X]
2  n <- length[Y]
3  for i <- 1 to m
4       do c[i, 0] <- 0
5  for j <- 1 to n
6       do c[0, j] <- 0
7  for i <- 1 to m
8       do for j <- 1 to n
9            do if x_i = y_j
10                 then c[i, j] <- __AAA__
11                      b[i, j] <- "↖"
12                 else if c[i-1, j] >= __BBB__
13                      then c[i, j] <- c[i-1, j]
14                           b[i, j] <- "↑"
15                      else c[i, j] <- __CCC__
16                           b[i, j] <- "←"
17 return __DDD__
選出正確的

正確答案：
AAA 是 c[i-1, j-1] + 1
BBB 是 c[i, j-1]
CCC 是 c[i, j-1]

MATRIX_CHAIN_ORDER(p)
1  n <- length[p] - 1
2  for i <- 1 to n
3       do m[i, i] <- 0
4  for ____1____
5       do for ____2____
6            do j <- i + l - 1
7               m[i, j] <- ∞
8               for ____3____
9                    do q <- m[i, k] + m[k + 1, j] + p_{i-1} * p_k * p_j
10                       if q < m[i, j]
11                            then m[i, j] <- q
12                                 s[i, j] <- k
13 return m and s
選出正確的

時間複雜度 O(n^3)
